def extract(s, ids, llm, st=None):
    st = st or settings()
    return ai.run_extraction(s, llm, st, ids, spec=ai.observation_spec(st), allow_full_run=True, sleep=lambda _: None)


def extract_all_direct(s, **fake_kw):
    cats = category_map(s)
    llm = FakeObserver(lambda fid: cats.get(fid, "OTHER"), **fake_kw)
    extract(s, sorted(cats), llm)
    return llm, cats


def version_id():
    return ai.current_observation_version_id(settings())


def select_all(s):
    return {r["requirement_id"]: sel.run_selection(s, r["requirement_id"], version_id(), USER) for r in rr.list_requirements(s)}


def make_agent(s, name, execution, method, resources, weight, **kw):

                                               scoring_method=method, resources=resources, weight_percent=weight, **kw),
                               USER)

def make_profile(s, weights: dict[str, float], name="Evidence profile"):
    prof = pp.create_profile(s, name, USER, weights=weights)
    pp.activate_profile(s, prof.profile_id, USER)
    return prof.profile_id


def expected_ids(cats, need_code, kinds):
    return sorted(fid for fid, code in cats.items() if code == need_code and kind(fid) in kinds)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1-7 extraction, validation, caching

def test_01_multiple_observations_per_comment(s):
    llm, cats = extract_all_direct(s)
    fid = next(f for f in sorted(cats) if kind(f) == 1)
    obs = ai.observations_for(s, [fid])
    assert [o.observation_type for o in obs] == ["COMPLAINT", "IMPROVEMENT_REQUEST"]
    assert len({o.observation_id for o in obs}) == 2 and all(o.observation_id.startswith("OBS-") for o in obs)


def test_02_03_complaint_request_and_positive_classification(s):
    _, cats = extract_all_direct(s)
    by_type = {}
    for o in ai.observations_for(s, sorted(cats)):
        by_type.setdefault(o.observation_type, set()).add(o.original_feedback_id)
    assert by_type["COMPLAINT"] == {f for f in cats if kind(f) in (0, 1)}
    assert by_type["IMPROVEMENT_REQUEST"] == {f for f in cats if kind(f) in (1, 3)}
    assert by_type["POSITIVE"] == {f for f in cats if kind(f) == 2}
    # the original VFC classification is preserved and separate
    assert s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Feedback)) >= 4000


def test_04_feedback_id_validation(s):
    cats = category_map(s)
    ids = sorted(cats)[:5]
    llm = FakeObserver(lambda f: cats.get(f, "OTHER"), extra_ids=["99999999", sorted(cats)[10]])
    extract(s, ids, llm)
    stored = {o.original_feedback_id for o in ai.observations_for(s)}

def test_05_evidence_excerpt_validation(s):

    assert ai.locate_excerpt("Great Car", "great car") is None  # case must match
    assert ai.locate_excerpt('"great   car"', "a great car") == "great car"


def test_06_unique_comment_deduplication(s):
    _, cats = extract_all_direct(s)
    for rid, selection in select_all(s).items():
        need = rr.get_requirement(s, rid).need_code

        assert len(selection.combined_demand_ids) == len(selection.supporting_complaint_ids) + \

def test_07_cached_extraction_reuse_and_versioned_keys(s):
    cats = category_map(s)
    ids = sorted(cats)[:12]

    job1 = extract(s, ids, llm)

    assert len(llm.calls) == calls and job2.cached_items == len(ids)  # no second request
    c = ai.load_comments(s, ids[:1])[0]
    k = ai.observation_cache_key(c.original_feedback_id, c.text_sha256, MODEL, MODEL)
    assert k != ai.observation_cache_key(c.original_feedback_id, c.text_sha256, MODEL, MODEL, taxonomy_version="other")
    assert k != ai.observation_cache_key(c.original_feedback_id, c.text_sha256, MODEL, "other-model-version")
    assert k != ai.cache_key(c.original_feedback_id, c.text_sha256, MODEL, ai.PROMPT_VERSION)  # Part 2 cache untouched
    # never silently overwrite a validated entry
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ai.observation_spec(settings()).store(s, job1, c, ai.FeedbackObservationResult(feedback_id=c.original_feedback_id,
                                                                                       observations=[]), MODEL, MODEL)

def demand_setup(s, human=True):
    extract_all_direct(s)
    select_all(s)
    a1 = make_agent(s, "Customer Demand", "AI_ANALYSIS", "COMBINED_CUSTOMER_DEMAND",
                    ["RES_AI_OBSERVATIONS", "RES_REQUIREMENTS"], 50)
    a2 = make_agent(s, "Complaints", "AI_ANALYSIS", "COMPLAINT_FREQUENCY", ["RES_AI_OBSERVATIONS", "RES_REQUIREMENTS"], 20)
    a3 = make_agent(s, "Impact", "HUMAN_ASSESSMENT", "HUMAN_SCORE", ["RES_HUMAN_ASSESSMENTS", "RES_REQUIREMENTS"], 30)
    pid = make_profile(s, {a1: 50, a2: 20, a3: 30})

           [(x.requirement_id, x.final_score, x.rank) for x in dp.ranking(s, r2.run_id)]
    assert dp.evidence_snapshot(s, r1.run_id) == dp.evidence_snapshot(s, r2.run_id)


def test_09_evidence_snapshot_preservation(s):

    row = next(r for r in sel.match_rows(s, frozen["selection_id"]) if r["ai_status"] == "PROPOSED")
    sel.review_match(s, rid, row["observation_id"], "REJECTED", "Not about this requirement", "reviewer.a")
    assert dp.evidence_snapshot(s, run.run_id) == snap
    assert [(x.requirement_id, x.final_score) for x in dp.ranking(s, run.run_id)] == before
    assert dp.verify_reproducibility(s, run.run_id)["reproducible"]


def test_10_scoring_normalization(s):
    assert REFERENCE_POPULATION_N == 4000 and NORMALIZATION["version"] == "log-feedback-v1"
    assert log_normalize(60) == round(100 * math.log(61) / math.log(4001), 2)

    pid, (a1, _, _) = demand_setup(s)
    run = dp.run_prioritization(s, pid, USER)
    for r in rr.list_requirements(s):

        assert res["score"] == round(100 * math.log1p(n) / math.log1p(4000), 2)
        assert res["inputs"]["N"] == 4000 and res["inputs"]["normalization"]["formula"] == "100 * ln(1 + n) / ln(1 + N)"
        assert "not a percentage" in res["inputs"]["normalization"]["interpretation"]
    assert s.get(ScoringMethodVersion, ("COMBINED_CUSTOMER_DEMAND", "1.0")) is not None

def test_14_uploaded_knowledge_retrieval_and_isolation(s):

def test_16_human_evidence_review(s):

    rows = sel.match_rows(s, selection.selection_id)
    proposed = next(r for r in rows if r["ai_status"] == "PROPOSED" and r["match_role"] == "COMPLAINT")
    assert proposed["original_comment"] and proposed["evidence_excerpt"] in proposed["original_comment"]
    with pytest.raises(sel.SelectionError):
        sel.review_match(s, rid, proposed["observation_id"], "REJECTED", "  ", "reviewer.a")
    with pytest.raises(sel.SelectionError):
        sel.review_match(s, rid, "OBS-DOESNOTEXIST", "ACCEPTED", "x", "reviewer.a")
    sel.review_match(s, rid, proposed["observation_id"], "REJECTED", "Mentions a different system", "reviewer.a")
    after = sel.get_selection(s, selection.selection_id)
    if kind(proposed["feedback_id"]) == 0:
        assert proposed["feedback_id"] not in after.supporting_complaint_ids
    assert proposed["feedback_id"] in after.rejected_ids or kind(proposed["feedback_id"]) == 1
    sel.review_match(s, rid, proposed["observation_id"], "ACCEPTED", "Re-checked: it is relevant", "reviewer.b")
    hist = sel.review_history(s, rid, proposed["observation_id"])
    assert [h["decision"] for h in hist] == ["ACCEPTED", "REJECTED"]  # append-only history
    # a new AI selection run never replaces the human decision
    extract(s, sorted(category_map(s))[:3], FakeObserver(lambda f: "OTHER"))
    again = sel.run_selection(s, rid, version_id(), USER)
    assert sel.latest_reviews(s, rid)[proposed["observation_id"]].decision == "ACCEPTED"
    assert proposed["feedback_id"] in again.supporting_complaint_ids

def test_19_historical_reproducibility_and_reanalysis(s):
    pid, (a1, a2, a3) = demand_setup(s)
    old = dp.run_prioritization(s, pid, USER)
    old_rows = [(r.requirement_id, r.final_score, r.rank) for r in dp.ranking(s, old.run_id)]
    rid = requirements(s)[0]["requirement_id"]
    current = sel.latest_selection(s, rid, version_id())
    target = next(r for r in sel.match_rows(s, current.selection_id)
                  if r["ai_status"] == "PROPOSED" and kind(r["feedback_id"]) == 0)
    sel.review_match(s, rid, target["observation_id"], "REJECTED", "Reviewer rejected", "reviewer.c")
    new, comparison = dp.reanalyze_with_new_evidence(s, old.run_id, USER)
    assert new.run_id != old.run_id and new.based_on_run_id == old.run_id
    assert [(r.requirement_id, r.final_score, r.rank) for r in dp.ranking(s, old.run_id)] == old_rows
    row = next(r for r in comparison["requirements"] if r["requirement_id"] == rid)
    assert row["new_evidence_counts"]["combined_demand"] == row["old_evidence_counts"]["combined_demand"] - 1
    demand = next(a for a in row["agents"] if a["agent"] == "Customer Demand")
    assert demand["new_n"] == demand["old_n"] - 1 and demand["new_score"] == log_normalize(demand["new_n"])

    assert status.budget_usd == 26.0 and status.spent_usd == 0 and status.remaining_usd == 26.0
    job = AIProcessingJob(job_id="JOB-PRIOR", job_type="observation", status="completed", vehicle_code="G60", model=MODEL,
                          prompt_version="observe-v1", selection_json="[]", batch_size=5, total_items=0,
                          processed_items=0, cached_items=0, failed_items=0, api_calls=0, input_tokens=0,
                          output_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=0, cache_write_tokens=0, estimated_cost_usd=25.99,
                          created_at=ai._now(), updated_at=ai._now())
    s.add(job)
    s.add(AIApiCall(job_id="JOB-PRIOR", batch_index=0, attempt=2, item_ids_json="[]", status="api_error", model=MODEL,
                    estimated_cost_usd=25.99, created_at=ai._now()))
    s.flush()
    status = budget.budget_status(s, st)

    llm = FakeObserver(lambda f: "OTHER")

    assert llm.calls == []
    # mid-run ceiling: the guard stops before a batch that would exceed the approval

    s.flush()
    cats = category_map(s)

                          sleep=lambda _: None)

"""Read-only decision context for the Part 6 Decision Assistant.

Everything returned here comes from stored records (runs, agent results,
assessments, evidence links, flags). The future assistant must use this
context instead of inventing scores or explanations. Nothing here writes to
the database or calls an LLM.

Supported questions (deterministic helpers):
  * why ranked first / which agent contributed most -> get_decision_context
  * which assessments are missing                   -> get_decision_context["missing_assessments"]
  * what if weights changed                          -> what_if_weights (recomputes from stored scores)
  * difference between two requirements              -> compare_requirements
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from core.prioritization_models import PriorityAssessment, PrioritizationRun, RequirementPriorityScore
from services.agent_explanations import summarize
from services.agent_weights import WeightEntry, percent_to_bp, validate_weights, weighted_contribution
from services.critical_issues import flags_for
from services.dynamic_prioritization import agent_results, latest_run_for
from services.requirement_review import get_requirement, requirement_as_dict


def get_decision_context(session: Session, requirement_id: str, run_id: str | None = None,
                         profile_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
    req = requirement_as_dict(session, get_requirement(session, requirement_id))
    run_id = run_id or latest_run_for(session, requirement_id, profile_id)
    base = {"requirement_id": requirement_id, "requirement_title": req["title"], "review_status": req["review_status"],
            "profile_id": None, "profile_version": None, "run_id": None, "priority_status": None, "final_score": None,
            "rank": None, "agent_contributions": [], "evidence_references": [], "human_assessments": [],
            "missing_assessments": [], "assumptions": list(req["assumptions"]), "limitations": [],
            "critical_flags": flags_for(session, requirement_id),
            "note": "Priority scores do not change approval status."}
    if run_id is None:
        base["limitations"].append("This requirement has not been prioritized yet.")
        return base
    run = session.get(PrioritizationRun, run_id)
    row = session.scalar(select(RequirementPriorityScore).where(RequirementPriorityScore.run_id == run_id,
                                                                RequirementPriorityScore.requirement_id == requirement_id))
    if run is None or row is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Requirement {requirement_id} is not part of run {run_id}")
    results = agent_results(session, run_id, requirement_id)
    explanations = [r["explanation"] for r in results]
    grouped = summarize(explanations)
    contributions = sorted(
        ({"agent_id": r["agent_id"], "agent_name": r["agent_name"], "agent_version": r["agent_version"],
          "scoring_method": r["scoring_method"], "scoring_version": r["scoring_version"], "status": r["status"],
          "score": r["score"], "weight_percent": r["weight_percent"], "weighted_contribution": r["weighted_contribution"],
          "rationale": r["rationale"], "explanation": r["explanation"]} for r in results),
        key=lambda c: -(c["weighted_contribution"] or -1))
    refs = []
    for r in results:
        for ref in r["source_refs"]:
            item = {"agent": r["agent_name"], **ref}
            if item not in refs:
                refs.append(item)
    return {**base, "profile_id": run.profile_id, "profile_version": run.profile_version, "run_id": run_id,
            "run_created_at": run.created_at.isoformat(), "priority_status": row.priority_status,
            "final_score": row.final_score, "rank": row.rank, "agent_contributions": contributions,
            "top_contributor": contributions[0]["agent_name"] if contributions and contributions[0]["weighted_contribution"] else None,
            "top_contributors": [c["agent_name"] for c in contributions
                                 if contributions and c["weighted_contribution"] is not None
                                 and c["weighted_contribution"] == contributions[0]["weighted_contribution"]],
            "evidence_references": refs,
            "human_assessments": _assessments(session, results),
            "missing_assessments": json.loads(row.missing_agents_json),
            "assumptions": base["assumptions"] + grouped["ASSUMPTION"],
            "limitations": grouped["LIMITATION"], "facts": grouped["FACT"],
            "critical_flags_at_run": json.loads(row.critical_flags_json)}


def _assessments(session: Session, results: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """The stored human assessments that the run's HUMAN_SCORE results used."""
    out = []
    for r in results:
        aid = r["inputs"].get("assessment_id")
        a = session.get(PriorityAssessment, aid) if aid else None
        if a is not None:
            out.append({"agent": r["agent_name"], "assessment_id": a.assessment_id, "score": a.score,
                        "rationale": a.rationale, "assessor_id": a.assessor_id,
                        "assessment_timestamp": a.assessment_timestamp.isoformat(),
                        "evidence_references": json.loads(a.evidence_refs_json), "superseded_since": a.superseded})
    return out


def what_if_weights(session: Session, run_id: str, weights: dict[str, object]) -> dict:
    """Recompute final scores of a stored run with different weights
    ({agent_id: percent}). Uses stored agent scores only - nothing is
    re-scored or saved. Weights must cover the run's agents and total 100%."""
    run = session.get(PrioritizationRun, run_id)
    if run is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown run {run_id!r}")
    agents = {a["agent_id"]: a for a in json.loads(run.profile_snapshot_json)["agents"]}
    if set(weights) != set(agents):
        raise ValueError("What-if weights must be given for exactly the run's agents.")
    bp = {aid: percent_to_bp(p) for aid, p in weights.items()}
    check = validate_weights([WeightEntry(agent_id=aid, weight_bp=v) for aid, v in bp.items()])
    if not check.valid:
        raise ValueError(" ".join(check.errors))
    out = []
    for rid in json.loads(run.requirement_ids_json):
        results = agent_results(session, run_id, rid)
        if any(r["status"] != "SCORED" for r in results):
            out.append({"requirement_id": rid, "priority_status": "INCOMPLETE", "final_score": None})
            continue
        total = sum((weighted_contribution(r["score"], bp[r["agent_id"]]) for r in results), Decimal("0"))
        out.append({"requirement_id": rid, "priority_status": "COMPLETE",
                    "final_score": float(total.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), ROUND_HALF_UP))})
    ranked = sorted((o for o in out if o["final_score"] is not None), key=lambda o: (-o["final_score"], o["requirement_id"]))
    previous, rank = None, 0
    for position, o in enumerate(ranked, start=1):
        if o["final_score"] != previous:
            rank, previous = position, o["final_score"]
        o["rank"] = rank
    return {"run_id": run_id, "weights_percent": {k: str(v) for k, v in weights.items()}, "results": out,
            "note": "Hypothetical recalculation from stored agent scores; not saved."}


def compare_requirements(session: Session, run_id: str, requirement_a: str, requirement_b: str) -> dict:
    a, b = (get_decision_context(session, r, run_id=run_id) for r in (requirement_a, requirement_b))
    by_agent = {}
    for side, ctx in (("a", a), ("b", b)):
        for c in ctx["agent_contributions"]:
            by_agent.setdefault(c["agent_name"], {})[side] = c
    rows = []
    for name, sides in by_agent.items():
        ca, cb = sides.get("a", {}), sides.get("b", {})
        diff = None
        if ca.get("weighted_contribution") is not None and cb.get("weighted_contribution") is not None:
            diff = round(ca["weighted_contribution"] - cb["weighted_contribution"], 4)
        rows.append({"agent": name, "score_a": ca.get("score"), "score_b": cb.get("score"),
                     "contribution_a": ca.get("weighted_contribution"), "contribution_b": cb.get("weighted_contribution"),
                     "contribution_difference": diff})
    return {"run_id": run_id, "requirement_a": requirement_a, "requirement_b": requirement_b,
            "final_score_a": a["final_score"], "final_score_b": b["final_score"], "rank_a": a["rank"], "rank_b": b["rank"],
            "agents": sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -abs(r["contribution_difference"] or 0))}
"""Structured, explainable agent results (Part 5).

Every statement is typed:
  FACT        directly supported by source data / calculation inputs
  ASSESSMENT  human-entered judgment
  ASSUMPTION  unverified input or prototype methodology
  LIMITATION  missing or unreliable evidence
Explanations are built only from the scoring result and stored evidence - no
customer opinions are generated. Stored as JSON for the Part 6 assistant.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from services.agent_scoring import ScoreResult, get_method


def build_explanation(result: ScoreResult, agent: dict, weight_bp: int, contribution: str | None) -> dict:
    method = get_method(result.method)
    items: list[dict] = []
    for fact in result.facts:
        items.append({"kind": "FACT", "text": fact})
    if result.source_refs:
        tables = sorted({r["table"] for r in result.source_refs})
        items.append({"kind": "FACT", "text": f"{len(result.source_refs)} source references ({', '.join(tables)}).",
                      "refs": [r["key"] for r in result.source_refs[:50]]})
    for a in result.assessments:
        items.append({"kind": "ASSESSMENT", "text": f"{a['assessor_id']} scored {a['score']}/100 on "
                                                    f"{a['timestamp'][:16]}: {a['rationale']}",
                      "refs": a.get("evidence_references", [])})
    for a in result.assumptions:
        items.append({"kind": "ASSUMPTION", "text": a})
    if result.status == "UNSCORED":
        items.append({"kind": "LIMITATION", "text": result.rationale})
    for lim in result.limitations + list(agent.get("limitations") or []):
        if {"kind": "LIMITATION", "text": lim} not in items:
            items.append({"kind": "LIMITATION", "text": lim})
    return {
        "agent_id": agent["agent_id"], "agent_name": agent["name"], "agent_version": agent["configuration_version"],
        "objective": agent["objective"], "status": result.status, "score": result.score,
        "score_label": method.score_label, "weight_percent": weight_bp / 100, "weighted_contribution": contribution,
        "methodology": {"scoring_method": method.method_id, "label": method.label, "version": method.version,
                        "execution_method": method.execution_method, "description": method.description,
                        "inputs": result.inputs},
        "rationale": result.rationale, "items": items,
    }


def summarize(explanations: list[dict]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """Group all typed statements of a requirement's agent explanations."""
    out: dict[str, list[str]] = {"FACT": [], "ASSESSMENT": [], "ASSUMPTION": [], "LIMITATION": []}
    for e in explanations:
        for item in e["items"]:
            text = f"[{e['agent_name']}] {item['text']}"
            if text not in out[item["kind"]]:
                out[item["kind"]].append(text)
    return out

"""Structured, evidence-bound multi-agent debate (Part 6).

Two saved requirements, one saved run. Each agent's "position" is built only
from its stored scores, rationales and contributions:

  ROUND 1  positions (favours A / favours B / no difference / unable to conclude)
  ROUND 2  disagreements between agents
  ROUND 3  criteria contributing most to the score difference
  ROUND 4  synthesis: agreement, disagreement, missing evidence, ranking under
           the run's profile, and sensitivity to single-agent weight changes

No arguments are invented, agents may abstain, and no winner is declared when
either requirement is incomplete.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from core.decision_models import AgentDebateSession
from core.prioritization_models import PriorityAssessment, RequirementPriorityScore
from services.decision_grounding import bind_run, historical_notices, run_agents
from services.dynamic_prioritization import agent_results

SENSITIVE_PP = 10  # a flip within +/-10 weight points counts as weight-sensitive


class AgentPosition(BaseModel):
    agent_id: str
    agent_name: str
    scoring_method: str
    weight_percent: float
    score_a: float | None
    score_b: float | None
    contribution_a: float | None
    contribution_b: float | None
    position: str  # FAVOURS_A | FAVOURS_B | NO_DIFFERENCE | UNABLE_TO_CONCLUDE
    basis_a: str
    basis_b: str
    evidence_a: int
    evidence_b: int
    limitations: list[str]


class DebateResult(BaseModel):
    debate_id: str | None
    run_id: str
    profile_id: str
    profile_version: int
    requirement_a: dict
    requirement_b: dict
    notices: list[str]
    round1_positions: list[AgentPosition]
    round2_disagreements: dict
    round3_drivers: list[dict]
    round4_synthesis: dict


def _basis(session: Session, result: dict) -> str:
    if result["status"] != "SCORED":
        return f"UNSCORED: {result['rationale']}"
    aid = result["inputs"].get("assessment_id")
    if aid:
        a = session.get(PriorityAssessment, aid)
        return f"Human assessment by {a.assessor_id}: {a.rationale}" if a else "Human assessment (record missing)"
    return result["rationale"]


def _sensitivity(positions: list[AgentPosition], diff: Decimal) -> list[dict]:
    """Weight-point shift to one agent (taken proportionally from the others)
    that would make the two final scores equal. Exact, from stored scores."""
    out = []
    usable = [p for p in positions if p.score_a is not None and p.score_b is not None]
    for p in usable:
        others = [q for q in usable if q.agent_id != p.agent_id]
        w_others = sum(Decimal(str(q.weight_percent)) for q in others)
        if not others or w_others == 0:
            continue
        avg_other = sum(Decimal(str(q.weight_percent)) * Decimal(str(q.score_a - q.score_b)) for q in others) / w_others
        d_i = Decimal(str(p.score_a - p.score_b))
        if d_i == avg_other:
            continue
        delta = -Decimal(100) * diff / (d_i - avg_other)
        new_weight = Decimal(str(p.weight_percent)) + delta
        if 0 <= new_weight <= 100 and delta <= w_others:
            out.append({"agent": p.agent_name, "weight_change_points": float(round(delta, 2)),
                        "weight_at_tie": float(round(new_weight, 2))})
    return sorted(out, key=lambda x: abs(x["weight_change_points"]))


def run_debate(session: Session, run_id: str, requirement_a: str, requirement_b: str, created_by: str | None = None,
               save: bool = False) -> DebateResult:
    if requirement_a == requirement_b:
        raise ValueError("Select two different requirements.")
    run = bind_run(session, run_id, requirement_a)
    bind_run(session, run_id, requirement_b)
    rows = {r.requirement_id: r for r in session.scalars(select(RequirementPriorityScore).where(
        RequirementPriorityScore.run_id == run_id, RequirementPriorityScore.requirement_id.in_([requirement_a, requirement_b])))}
    res_a = {r["agent_id"]: r for r in agent_results(session, run_id, requirement_a)}
    res_b = {r["agent_id"]: r for r in agent_results(session, run_id, requirement_b)}

    positions = []
    for agent in run_agents(run):
        ra, rb = res_a[agent["agent_id"]], res_b[agent["agent_id"]]
        if ra["status"] == "SCORED" and rb["status"] == "SCORED":
            pos = "FAVOURS_A" if ra["score"] > rb["score"] else "FAVOURS_B" if rb["score"] > ra["score"] else "NO_DIFFERENCE"
        else:
            pos = "UNABLE_TO_CONCLUDE"
        positions.append(AgentPosition(
            agent_id=agent["agent_id"], agent_name=agent["name"], scoring_method=agent["scoring_method"],
            weight_percent=agent["weight_bp"] / 100, score_a=ra["score"], score_b=rb["score"],
            contribution_a=ra["weighted_contribution"], contribution_b=rb["weighted_contribution"], position=pos,
            basis_a=_basis(session, ra), basis_b=_basis(session, rb), evidence_a=len(ra["source_refs"]),
            evidence_b=len(rb["source_refs"]), limitations=sorted(set(ra["limitations"]) | set(rb["limitations"]))))

    favours = {k: [p.agent_name for p in positions if p.position == k]
               for k in ("FAVOURS_A", "FAVOURS_B", "NO_DIFFERENCE", "UNABLE_TO_CONCLUDE")}
    disagreements = {**favours, "agents_disagree": bool(favours["FAVOURS_A"] and favours["FAVOURS_B"])}
    drivers = sorted(({"agent": p.agent_name, "contribution_a": p.contribution_a, "contribution_b": p.contribution_b,
                       "difference": round(p.contribution_a - p.contribution_b, 4)}
                      for p in positions if p.contribution_a is not None and p.contribution_b is not None),
                     key=lambda d: -abs(d["difference"]))

    ra_row, rb_row = rows[requirement_a], rows[requirement_b]
    complete = ra_row.priority_status == "COMPLETE" and rb_row.priority_status == "COMPLETE"
    missing = sorted({f"{p.agent_name} ({'A' if p.score_a is None else ''}{'B' if p.score_b is None else ''})"
                      for p in positions if p.position == "UNABLE_TO_CONCLUDE"})
    if complete:
        diff = Decimal(str(ra_row.final_score)) - Decimal(str(rb_row.final_score))
        higher = ("A" if diff > 0 else "B" if diff < 0 else "tie")
        ranking = (f"Under profile {run.profile_id} v{run.profile_version}, requirement "
                   f"{'A ranks higher' if higher == 'A' else 'B ranks higher' if higher == 'B' else 'A and B are tied'} "
                   f"({ra_row.final_score} vs {rb_row.final_score}; ranks {ra_row.rank} vs {rb_row.rank}).")
        flips = _sensitivity(positions, diff)
        sensitivity = {"margin_points": float(diff), "single_agent_shifts_to_tie": flips,
                       "classification": ("weight-sensitive" if flips and abs(flips[0]["weight_change_points"]) <= SENSITIVE_PP
                                          else "robust to single-agent weight changes of up to "
                                               f"{SENSITIVE_PP} points")}
    else:
        ranking = ("No ranking comparison: "
                   + ", ".join(f"requirement {k} is INCOMPLETE" for k, r in (("A", ra_row), ("B", rb_row))
                               if r.priority_status != "COMPLETE") + ". No winner is declared.")
        sensitivity = {"margin_points": None, "single_agent_shifts_to_tie": [], "classification": "not computable"}
    deciding = favours["FAVOURS_A"] + favours["FAVOURS_B"]
    if not deciding:
        agreement = "No agent could favour either requirement (scores missing or equal)."
    elif not favours["FAVOURS_B"]:
        agreement = f"All {len(deciding)} deciding agents favour A: {', '.join(favours['FAVOURS_A'])}."
    elif not favours["FAVOURS_A"]:
        agreement = f"All {len(deciding)} deciding agents favour B: {', '.join(favours['FAVOURS_B'])}."
    else:
        agreement = (f"Agents are split: {', '.join(favours['FAVOURS_A'])} favour A; "
                     f"{', '.join(favours['FAVOURS_B'])} favour B.")
    synthesis = {
        "agreement": agreement,
        "disagree": disagreements["agents_disagree"],
        "missing_evidence": missing,
        "ranking_under_profile": ranking,
        "sensitivity": sensitivity,
        "note": "Synthesis is computed from stored scores; it is not an official decision.",
    }

                          "final_score": r.final_score, "rank": r.rank}
    result = DebateResult(debate_id=None, run_id=run_id, profile_id=run.profile_id, profile_version=run.profile_version,
                          requirement_a=req_info(ra_row), requirement_b=req_info(rb_row),
                          notices=historical_notices(session, run), round1_positions=positions,
                          round2_disagreements=disagreements, round3_drivers=drivers, round4_synthesis=synthesis)

        if not (created_by or "").strip():
            raise ValueError("A user identifier is required to save a debate.")
        debate_id = f"DBT-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10].upper()}"

            requirement_a=requirement_a, requirement_b=requirement_b,

            differences_json=json.dumps({"disagreements": disagreements, "drivers": drivers}),
            synthesis_json=json.dumps(synthesis), created_by=created_by.strip(),
            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)))

def list_debates(session: Session, run_id: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    stmt = select(AgentDebateSession).order_by(AgentDebateSession.created_at.desc())
    if run_id:
        stmt = stmt.where(AgentDebateSession.run_id == run_id)

             "requirement_a": d.requirement_a, "requirement_b": d.requirement_b,
             "synthesis": json.loads(d.synthesis_json), "created_by": d.created_by, "created_at": d.created_at}

"""Agent-specific discussion (Part 6).

The assistant adopts one agent's perspective using ONLY that agent's
configuration as stored in the selected run snapshot (method, version,
resources) and its stored result. Agents are discovered dynamically from the
run - custom agents get the same treatment - and nothing is inferred from an
agent's name.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from core.prioritization_models import PriorityAssessment
from services.agent_resources import RESOURCES, list_resources
from services.agent_scoring import METHODS
from services.decision_grounding import AssistantResponse, bind_run, finalize, historical_notices, run_agents
from services.dynamic_prioritization import agent_results

TOPICS = ("why_score", "method", "evidence", "limitations")


def run_agent_options(session: Session, run_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    run = bind_run(session, run_id)
    return [{"agent_id": a["agent_id"], "name": a["name"], "scoring_method": a["scoring_method"],
             "execution_method": a["execution_method"], "weight_percent": a["weight_bp"] / 100,
             "configuration_version": a["configuration_version"]} for a in run_agents(run)]


def discuss_agent(session: Session, run_id: str, requirement_id: str, agent_id: str, topic: str = "why_score"
                  ) -> AssistantResponse:
    if topic not in TOPICS:
        raise ValueError(f"Topic must be one of {TOPICS}")
    run = bind_run(session, run_id, requirement_id)
    agent = next((a for a in run_agents(run) if a["agent_id"] == agent_id), None)
    resp = AssistantResponse(intent="agent_discussion", title="", requirement_id=requirement_id, run_id=run_id,
                             profile_id=run.profile_id, profile_version=run.profile_version, agent_id=agent_id,
                             notices=historical_notices(session, run, requirement_id))
    if agent is None:
        resp.title = "Agent not part of this run"
        resp.needs_clarification = True
        resp.add("LIMITATION", f"Agent {agent_id} was not used in run {run_id}. Select one of the run's agents.")
        resp.suggestions = [a["name"] for a in run_agents(run)]
        return resp
    result = next(r for r in agent_results(session, run_id, requirement_id) if r["agent_id"] == agent_id)
    method = METHODS[agent["scoring_method"]]
    resp.title = f"{agent['name']} (v{agent['configuration_version']}) on {requirement_id}"

    if topic in ("why_score", "method"):
        resp.add("FACT", f"This agent is configured with the scoring method '{method.label}' "
                         f"(v{result['scoring_version']}, execution {agent['execution_method']}); its behaviour comes from "
                         f"this configuration, not from its name. Objective as configured: {agent['objective']}")
        resp.add("FACT", "Assigned resources: " + ", ".join(RESOURCES[r].name for r in agent["resources"] if r in RESOURCES) + ".")
        counts = {r.resource_id: r.available_records for r in list_resources(session)}
        resp.add("FACT", "Resource availability (current data, not the run snapshot): "
                 + "; ".join(f"{RESOURCES[r].name}: {counts.get(r)} records" for r in agent["resources"] if r in RESOURCES) + ".")
        resp.add("FACT", f"Method: {method.description}")

    if topic == "why_score":
        if result["status"] == "SCORED":
            resp.add("FACT", f"Stored score {result['score']} × weight {result['weight_percent']}% = weighted contribution "
                             f"{result['weighted_contribution']} points (run {run_id}).")
            inputs = result["inputs"]
            if "unique_g60_feedback_ids" in inputs:
                resp.add("FACT", f"{inputs['unique_g60_feedback_ids']} distinct G60 comments linked as direct evidence; "
                                 f"reference population {inputs['reference_population']} distinct G60 comments; formula "
                                 f"{inputs['formula']}.")
            if "covered_evidence_types" in inputs:
                per = "; ".join(f"{v['label']}: {v['valid_links']}" for v in inputs["per_type"].values())
                resp.add("FACT", f"Evidence coverage {inputs['covered_evidence_types']} of {inputs['assigned_evidence_types']} "
                                 f"assigned types ({per}). This measures coverage, not customer impact.")
            if "assessment_id" in inputs:
                a = session.get(PriorityAssessment, inputs["assessment_id"])
                if a is None:
                    resp.add("LIMITATION", "The stored assessment record could not be found.")
                else:
                    resp.add("ASSESSMENT", f"{a.assessor_id} scored {a.score}/100 on {a.assessment_timestamp:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M}. "
                                           f"Rationale: {a.rationale.strip() or 'No rationale was provided.'}",
                             refs=[a.assessment_id])
                    if a.superseded:
                        resp.add("LIMITATION", "This assessment has since been superseded by a newer one; it was the "
                                               "current assessment when the run was executed.")
        else:
            resp.add("LIMITATION", f"UNSCORED: {result['rationale']}")
            if agent["scoring_method"] == "HUMAN_SCORE":
                resp.add("LIMITATION", "Missing: a human assessment (score 0-100 with rationale) for this agent and "
                                       "requirement. Enter it in Agent Prioritization → Execution, then re-run.")
            elif result["inputs"].get("invalid_ids") or result["inputs"].get("non_g60_ids"):
                resp.add("LIMITATION", "Missing: valid G60 evidence. The requirement's evidence contains invalid or non-G60 IDs.")
            elif "prerequisites" in result["inputs"]:
                resp.add("LIMITATION", "Missing: validated market prerequisites "
                                       + ", ".join(k for k, ok in result["inputs"]["prerequisites"].items() if not ok) + ".")

    if topic in ("why_score", "evidence"):
        refs = [{"table": r["table"], "key": r["key"]} for r in result["source_refs"] if r["table"] != "evidence"]
        resp.evidence_refs = refs
        if refs:
            resp.add("FACT", f"{len(refs)} source references were stored with this result.", refs=[r["key"] for r in refs[:15]])
        else:
            resp.add("LIMITATION", "No source references were stored with this result.")

    if topic in ("why_score", "limitations"):
        for item in result["explanation"]["items"]:
            if item["kind"] == "ASSUMPTION":
                resp.add("ASSUMPTION", item["text"])
        for lim in result["limitations"]:
            resp.add("LIMITATION", lim)
    return finalize(session, resp)

def counts_by_category(session: Session, settings: LLMSettings) -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:
    """{need_code: {observation_type: distinct comments}} for the current version."""
    version_id = ai.current_observation_version_id(settings)
    out: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    for code, otype, n in session.execute(
        select(AIFeedbackObservation.taxonomy_category, AIFeedbackObservation.observation_type,
               func.count(func.distinct(AIFeedbackObservation.original_feedback_id)))
        .where(AIFeedbackObservation.version_id == version_id)
        .group_by(AIFeedbackObservation.taxonomy_category, AIFeedbackObservation.observation_type)
    ):
        out.setdefault(code, {})[otype] = n
    return out


def need_summary(session: Session, settings: LLMSettings, need_code: str, limit: int = 8) -> dict:
    """AI-identified needs in one category: distinct-comment counts per type,
    the most frequent need phrases, and example observations with the original
    comment text (all from validated observations)."""
    from core.models import Feedback

    version_id = ai.current_observation_version_id(settings)
    obs = list(session.scalars(select(AIFeedbackObservation).where(
        AIFeedbackObservation.version_id == version_id, AIFeedbackObservation.taxonomy_category == need_code)
        .order_by(AIFeedbackObservation.original_feedback_id, AIFeedbackObservation.observation_index)))
    by_type: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    phrases: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for o in obs:
        by_type.setdefault(o.observation_type, set()).add(o.original_feedback_id)
        key = " ".join(o.customer_need.lower().split())
        phrases.setdefault(key, set()).add(o.original_feedback_id)
    top = sorted(phrases.items(), key=lambda kv: (-len(kv[1]), kv[0]))[:limit]
    examples = [o for o in obs if o.observation_type in ("COMPLAINT", "IMPROVEMENT_REQUEST")][:limit]
    texts = dict(session.execute(select(Feedback.original_feedback_id, Feedback.customer_feedback).where(
        Feedback.original_feedback_id.in_({o.original_feedback_id for o in examples}), Feedback.vehicle_code == "G60")).all())
    return {"comments_by_type": {k: len(v) for k, v in by_type.items()},
            "top_needs": [{"customer_need": k, "comments": len(v)} for k, v in top],
            "examples": [{"feedback_id": o.original_feedback_id, "observation_type": o.observation_type,
                          "customer_need": o.customer_need, "evidence_excerpt": o.evidence_excerpt,
                          "original_comment": texts.get(o.original_feedback_id)} for o in examples]}


def sample_review_rows(session: Session, job_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Observations produced for one job's comments (for extraction-quality review)."""
    job = session.get(AIProcessingJob, job_id)
    if job is None:
        return []
    ids = json.loads(job.selection_json)
    rows = []
    for o in ai.observations_for(session, ids):
        rows.append({"feedback_id": o.original_feedback_id, "type": o.observation_type, "category": o.taxonomy_category,
                     "customer_need": o.customer_need, "excerpt": o.evidence_excerpt, "confidence": o.confidence})
    return rows

Excerpts must be found verbatim (case-sensitive) or the observation is rejected and logged. Observation IDs are generated in Python. Cache key = feedback ID + text hash + model + model version + prompt version + taxonomy version; validated entries are never overwritten (new versions sit next to old ones in `observation_versions`). Shares batching, retries, checkpoint/resume and usage logging with Part 2. |
| Cost control | `services/llm_budget.py`, `services/evidence_extraction.py` | $26 application budget (`PRODUCTMIND_LLM_BUDGET_USD`), spend = sum of logged calls incl. retries, pre-request estimate (measured from the sample once it ran), explicit `approved_max_usd`, per-batch ceiling guard (job stops resumably), 20-comment representative sample required before a confirmed full run. Fallback model off. |
| Selection (`select-v1`) | `services/ai_evidence_selector.py` | Per requirement version: taxonomy matching on its direct comments → complaint / request / positive / counter-evidence / uncertain ID lists (distinct feedback IDs; combined demand = union). Optional paid LLM semantic matching re-judges only uncertain matches and creates a new immutable selection. Human reviews (accept / reject / uncertain + justification, append-only) override every AI run. |
| Scoring | `services/agent_scoring.py`, `services/custom_metrics.py` | `COMPLAINT_FREQUENCY`, `CUSTOMER_REQUEST_FREQUENCY`, `COMBINED_CUSTOMER_DEMAND` (AI_ANALYSIS): score = 100·ln(1+n)/ln(1+N), N = 4000 fixed (`log-feedback-v1`) - a normalised frequency index, not a % of customers. UNSCORED without a selection or with incomplete extraction coverage. `EVIDENCE_COVERAGE` v1.1 also covers AI observations and uploads. `DOCUMENTED_CUSTOM_METRIC` runs only code-implemented, admin-approved metrics. content.text:
The 2.0 upgrade is built and tested, but no real AI calls have been made yet, so there are no real observations. All 213 tests pass: 188 existing plus 25 new covering your 22 items, with the external API faked in every test. Spending is $0.00 and the full $26.00 budget remains. No API key is configured on this machine.

**What changed in the live app**
- **Database:** I backed it up first to `database/productmind.backup-before-2.0.db`. The migration only added things: 9 new tables and 5 new columns on existing tables.
- **Your data:** your 1 requirement, 7 agents, 1 profile and 2 runs are intact. Both runs recompute to exactly their stored scores from saved inputs.
- **Dashboard:** restarted on localhost:8501 so it loads the new code. Every page loads without errors on a copy of your data. My headless-browser screenshots only captured the loading screen, so I haven't visually checked the new screens. Please look at them in your browser.

**How it works**
- **Extraction (versioned `observe-v1`):** each G60 comment can yield several observations: complaint, improvement request, positive, neutral or unclear. Each quote must appear word for word in the original comment, or that observation is rejected and logged. Results are cached and never overwritten.
- **Evidence selection (`select-v1`):** each requirement gets lists of distinct comment IDs for complaints, requests, positives, counter-evidence and uncertain matches. Combined demand counts a comment with both a complaint and a request once. Human accept/reject/uncertain reviews always override AI matches.
- **Scoring (`log-feedback-v1`):** three new AI-analysis methods (complaint frequency, request frequency, combined demand) use score = 100·ln(1+n)/ln(1+4000). Python counts and calculates; the model never chooses a number. An agent is UNSCORED unless every direct comment for that requirement has been extracted.
- **Snapshots:** each run freezes the evidence it used, so a saved run never changes. "Reanalyze With New Evidence" creates a new run plus a comparison.
- **Screens:**
  - DISCOVER shows extraction status, the budget and the sample run.
  - DEFINE has evidence selection and the review workflow.
  - PRIORITIZE shows the calculation behind each score and the seven-field agent builder with file uploads.
  - DECIDE adds an evidence-aware debate in which agents abstain when evidence is missing, history/reanalysis, human approval and export.

**Decisions I made that you may want to change**
- **Approval threshold:** your approval must cover the cost estimate, not the worst case with retries. The full-run worst case ($29.69) is above $26, so it could never have been approved. A per-batch check stops the job before it exceeds your approved amount or the budget, and it can be resumed.
- **Full run is terminal-only:** it takes too long to run inside the dashboard. It is blocked until a 20-comment sample has completed.
- **Dashboard paid buttons:** the sample run and an optional AI relevance check for uncertain matches can be started from the dashboard. Both go through the same approval and budget checks. I updated the old Part 3 "dashboard never touches the LLM" test to allow this.
- **Custom metrics:** only metrics written in code can run, and only after an admin approves them from the terminal. There is one so far: the share of an agent's uploaded document passages that mention the requirement.
- **Kept names:** the human method keeps its original name (`HUMAN_SCORE`) so your existing agents still work.

**Cost estimates (rough, not measured yet)**

| Batch | Estimate | Worst case with retries |
|---|---|---|
| 20-comment sample | $0.10 | $0.16 |
| All 4,000 comments | $19.79 | $29.69 |

The full-run figure is a rough estimate based on comment length. Once the sample has run, estimates use the measured token usage instead.

**To run the 20-comment sample (I have not run it)**
```bash
export PRODUCTMIND_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_LLM=1 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...
python -m scripts.customer_intelligence observe --sample 20                     # estimate only
python -m scripts.customer_intelligence observe --sample 20 --approve-usd 0.50  # paid
```
After that, check the sample's quality on the DISCOVER page before any full run. The full run needs `--all --confirm-full-run --approve-usd X`.

**Known limitations**
- Selection accuracy against real model output is unmeasured until the sample runs.
- Uploaded documents are searched by keyword only.
- Matches the AI proposes still count toward scores before a person reviews them. They pass the ID and exact-quote checks, and the review counts are shown next to every score.
- Spend is an estimate from token usage at list prices, not a provider bill.

New files: `core/evidence_models.py`, `services/ai_evidence_selector.py`, `services/evidence_extraction.py`, `services/llm_budget.py`, `services/agent_documents.py`, `services/custom_metrics.py`, `ui/evidence_ui.py`, `tests/test_evidence_first.py`. The README has a new 2.0 section. Nothing is committed or pushed.

    cached input; ``output_tokens`` include reasoning tokens (billed as output).
    """

    provider = "openai"

    def __init__(self, settings: LLMSettings, client: Any | None = None):
        import openai  # imported lazily so tests and offline commands never need it

        self._openai = openai
        self.settings = settings
        self.model = settings.model
        self._client = client or openai.OpenAI(max_retries=0)

    def _params(self, system: str, user: str, schema: dict[str, Any], max_tokens: int,
                name: str = "structured_output") -> dict[str, Any]:
        params: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": self.model,
            "instructions": system,  # stable prefix -> OpenAI automatic prompt caching
            "input": user,
            "max_output_tokens": max_tokens,
            "store": False,  # do not retain BMW data in OpenAI response storage
            "text": {"format": {"type": "json_schema", "name": name, "schema": schema, "strict": True}},
        }
        if self.settings.effort:
            params["reasoning"] = {"effort": self.settings.effort}
        return params

    def complete_json(self, *, system: str, user: str, schema: dict[str, Any], max_tokens: int) -> LLMResponse:
        o = self._openai
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            response = self._client.responses.create(**self._params(system, user, schema, max_tokens))
        except o.RateLimitError as exc:
            retry_after = exc.response.headers.get("retry-after") if getattr(exc, "response", None) is not None else None
            raise LLMError(_safe(exc), kind="rate_limited", retryable=True,
                           retry_after_s=float(retry_after) if retry_after else None) from exc
        except (o.AuthenticationError, o.PermissionDeniedError) as exc:
            raise LLMError(_safe(exc), kind="auth", retryable=False) from exc
        except o.APIStatusError as exc:
            retryable = exc.status_code >= 500 or exc.status_code in (408, 409)
            raise LLMError(_safe(exc), kind="api_error" if retryable else "bad_request", retryable=retryable) from exc
        except o.APIConnectionError as exc:  # includes timeouts
            raise LLMError(_safe(exc), kind="connection", retryable=True) from exc
        return _openai_response(response, self.model, int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))


def _safe(exc: Exception) -> str:
    """Error text without request bodies (no customer feedback in logs)."""
    status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
    message = getattr(exc, "message", None) or exc.__class__.__name__
    return f"{exc.__class__.__name__}{f' {status}' if status else ''}: {str(message)[:300]}"


def _openai_response(response: Any, model: str, latency_ms: int | None) -> LLMResponse:
    usage = getattr(response, "usage", None)
    total_in = getattr(usage, "input_tokens", 0) or 0
    cached = getattr(getattr(usage, "input_tokens_details", None), "cached_tokens", 0) or 0
    text_parts, refused = [], False
    for item in getattr(response, "output", None) or []:
        for part in getattr(item, "content", None) or []:
            kind = getattr(part, "type", None)
            if kind == "output_text":
                text_parts.append(part.text)
            elif kind == "refusal":
                refused = True
    status = getattr(response, "status", None)
    reason = getattr(getattr(response, "incomplete_details", None), "reason", None)
    if refused:
        stop = "refusal"
    elif status == "incomplete" and reason == "max_output_tokens":
        stop = "max_tokens"
    elif status == "incomplete" and reason == "content_filter":
        stop = "refusal"
    else:
        stop = "end_turn" if status in (None, "completed") else str(status)
    return LLMResponse(
        text="".join(text_parts) or None, stop_reason=stop, model=getattr(response, "model", None) or model,
        request_id=getattr(response, "_request_id", None) or getattr(response, "id", None),
        usage=LLMUsage(input_tokens=max(total_in - cached, 0), output_tokens=getattr(usage, "output_tokens", 0) or 0,
                       cache_read_tokens=cached, cache_write_tokens=0),
        latency_ms=latency_ms,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Provider selection (single provider, no cross-provider fallback)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class ProviderNotConfigured(RuntimeError):
    pass


def credential_present(settings: LLMSettings) -> bool:
    if settings.provider == "anthropic":
        from pathlib import Path

        return any(os.getenv(v) for v in CREDENTIAL_ENV["anthropic"]) or (Path.home() / ".config" / "anthropic").exists()
    return any(os.getenv(v) for v in CREDENTIAL_ENV.get(settings.provider, ()))


def setup_instructions(settings: LLMSettings) -> str:
    var = CREDENTIAL_ENV.get(settings.provider, ("OPENAI_API_KEY",))[0]
    return (f"No API key for provider '{settings.provider}'. Set it in your shell (never in code or committed files):\\n"
            f"  export {var}=...\\n  export PRODUCTMIND_LLM_PROVIDER={settings.provider}\\n"
            "  export PRODUCTMIND_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_LLM=1\\n  export PRODUCTMIND_MAX_API_SPEND_USD=26")


def make_llm_client(settings: LLMSettings) -> LLMClient:
    """Client for the configured provider only. Raises ProviderNotConfigured
    instead of switching providers."""
    if settings.provider not in LLM_PROVIDERS:
        raise ProviderNotConfigured(f"Unknown LLM provider {settings.provider!r}; choose one of {', '.join(LLM_PROVIDERS)}.")
    if not credential_present(settings):
        raise ProviderNotConfigured(setup_instructions(settings))
    if settings.provider == "openai":
        return OpenAILLMClient(settings)
    return AnthropicLLMClient(settings)

"""One-request provider connection test (Stage 1 - OpenAI).

Sends a single minimal structured-output request that contains NO BMW data,
validates the reply with Pydantic, and logs the attempt in ``ai_api_calls``
under a ``connection_test`` job so it counts against the application budget.
Nothing is faked: success is reported only when the API answered with valid
structured output.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import secrets
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from core.ai_models import AIProcessingJob
from core.config import LLMSettings
from services import ai_feedback_analysis as ai
from services.llm_budget import budget_status
from services.llm_client import LLMClient, LLMError, LLMUsage, estimate_cost_usd

PROMPT_VERSION = "connection-test-v1"
SYSTEM = "You are a connection test for a software application. Reply only with the requested JSON."
SCHEMA = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["ok"]}, "echo": {"type": "string"}},
    "required": ["status", "echo"],
    "additionalProperties": False,
}
ESTIMATE_USAGE = LLMUsage(input_tokens=120, output_tokens=300)  # generous; includes possible reasoning tokens
MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 500


class _Reply(BaseModel):
    status: str
    echo: str


@dataclass
class ConnectionResult:
    success: bool
    provider: str
    model_requested: str
    model_reported: str | None = None
    usage: LLMUsage = field(default_factory=LLMUsage)
    estimated_cost_usd: float = 0.0
    request_id: str | None = None
    job_id: str | None = None
    error: str | None = None


def estimated_test_cost(settings: LLMSettings) -> float:
    return estimate_cost_usd(settings.model, ESTIMATE_USAGE)


def run_connection_test(session: Session, settings: LLMSettings, llm: LLMClient) -> ConnectionResult:
    """Caller must have obtained explicit confirmation. Checks the budget,
    sends ONE request, validates it and logs usage/cost."""
    estimate = estimated_test_cost(settings)
    remaining = budget_status(session, settings).remaining_usd
    if estimate > remaining:
        return ConnectionResult(False, settings.provider, settings.model,
                                error=f"Estimated ${estimate:.4f} exceeds the remaining budget ${remaining:.4f}.")
    nonce = f"PING-{secrets.token_hex(4).upper()}"
    job = AIProcessingJob(
        job_id=f"JOB-{ai._now():%Y%m%d%H%M%S}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}", job_type="connection_test", status="running",
        vehicle_code="-", model=settings.model, prompt_version=PROMPT_VERSION, selection_json="[]",
        selection_description=f"{settings.provider} connection test (no BMW data)", batch_size=1, total_items=1,
        processed_items=0, cached_items=0, failed_items=0, api_calls=0, input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0,
        cache_read_tokens=0, cache_write_tokens=0, estimated_cost_usd=0.0, created_at=ai._now(), updated_at=ai._now())
    session.add(job)
    session.flush()
    result = ConnectionResult(False, settings.provider, settings.model, job_id=job.job_id)
    try:
        resp = llm.complete_json(system=SYSTEM, user=f'Return status "ok" and echo exactly: {nonce}',
                                 schema=SCHEMA, max_tokens=MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS)
    except LLMError as exc:
        ai._log_call(session, job, 0, 1, [], "rate_limited" if exc.kind == "rate_limited" else "api_error",
                     settings.model, exc.usage, error=str(exc)[:500])
        result.error = f"{exc.kind}: {exc}"
    else:
        result.model_reported, result.usage, result.request_id = resp.model, resp.usage, resp.request_id
        status, error = "succeeded", None
        try:
            reply = _Reply.model_validate_json(resp.text or "")
            if resp.stop_reason != "end_turn":
                error = f"Response stopped with {resp.stop_reason}."
            elif reply.status != "ok" or reply.echo.strip() != nonce:
                error = "Response did not match the requested content."
        except ValidationError:
            error = f"Response was not valid structured JSON (stop_reason={resp.stop_reason})."
        if error:
            status = "invalid_output"
        result.estimated_cost_usd = ai._log_call(session, job, 0, 1, [], status, resp.model, resp.usage,
                                                 request_id=resp.request_id, stop_reason=resp.stop_reason,
                                                 latency_ms=resp.latency_ms, error=error)
        result.success, result.error = error is None, error
    job.status = "completed" if result.success else "failed"
    job.processed_items, job.failed_items = (1, 0) if result.success else (0, 1)
    job.last_error, job.updated_at = result.error, ai._now()
    session.flush()
    return result


def schema_is_strict(schema: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Problems that OpenAI strict structured outputs would reject: every
    object needs additionalProperties=false and all properties required."""
    problems: list[str] = []

    def walk(node, path):
        if isinstance(node, dict):
            if node.get("type") == "object":
                props = node.get("properties", {})
                if node.get("additionalProperties") is not False:
                    problems.append(f"{path}: additionalProperties must be false")
                if set(node.get("required", [])) != set(props):
                    problems.append(f"{path}: all properties must be required")
            for k, v in node.items():
                walk(v, f"{path}.{k}")
        elif isinstance(node, list):
            for i, v in enumerate(node):
                walk(v, f"{path}[{i}]")
    walk(schema, "$")
    if schema.get("type") != "object":
        problems.append("$: root must be an object")
    return problems


def describe(result: ConnectionResult) -> str:
    u = result.usage
    return json.dumps({"success": result.success, "provider": result.provider, "model_requested": result.model_requested,
                       "model_reported": result.model_reported, "input_tokens_uncached": u.input_tokens,
                       "cached_input_tokens": u.cache_read_tokens, "output_tokens": u.output_tokens,
                       "reasoning_tokens_in_output": u.reasoning_tokens,
                       "estimated_cost_usd": result.estimated_cost_usd, "error": result.error}, indent=1)

def settings(**kw) -> LLMSettings:

                                 max_attempts=3, external_calls_authorized=True, budget_usd=26.0), **kw})


def status_error(cls, code, headers=None):
    return cls("boom", response=httpx.Response(code, request=REQ, headers=headers or {}), body=None)


def fake_response(text, *, status="completed", reason=None, refusal=False, inp=1000, cached=600, out=300, reasoning=40):
    content = [SimpleNamespace(type="refusal", refusal="no")] if refusal else [SimpleNamespace(type="output_text", text=text)]
    return SimpleNamespace(
        id="resp_test", model=MODEL + "-2026-09-01", status=status,
        incomplete_details=SimpleNamespace(reason=reason) if reason else None,
        output=[SimpleNamespace(type="message", content=content)],
        usage=SimpleNamespace(input_tokens=inp, output_tokens=out,
                              input_tokens_details=SimpleNamespace(cached_tokens=cached),
                              output_tokens_details=SimpleNamespace(reasoning_tokens=reasoning)))


class FakeSDK:
    """Stand-in for ``openai.OpenAI``: records requests, replays scripted outcomes."""

    def __init__(self, outcomes=None, builder=None):
        self.requests: list[dict] = []
        self.outcomes = list(outcomes or [])
        self.builder = builder
        self.responses = SimpleNamespace(create=self._create)
        self.models = SimpleNamespace(retrieve=lambda model: SimpleNamespace(id=model))

    def _create(self, **params):
        self.requests.append(params)
        if self.outcomes:
            o = self.outcomes.pop(0)
            if isinstance(o, Exception):
                raise o
            return o
        return self.builder(params)


def observation_builder(category_for):
    """Valid observe-v1 output built from the comments in the request."""
    def build(params):
        payload = json.loads(params["input"].split("\n\n", 1)[1])
        results = []
        for p in payload:
            text, fid = p["comment"], p["feedback_id"]
            obs = [{"observation_type": "COMPLAINT" if kind(fid) in (0, 1) else "POSITIVE",
                    "customer_need": "need", "vehicle_system": "system",
                    "evidence_excerpt": text[: max(1, min(30, len(text) // 2))], "confidence": "high",
                    "taxonomy_category": category_for(fid)}]
            if kind(fid) in (1, 3):
                obs.append({"observation_type": "IMPROVEMENT_REQUEST", "customer_need": "change",
                            "vehicle_system": "system", "evidence_excerpt": text[len(text) // 2:],
                            "confidence": "medium", "taxonomy_category": category_for(fid)})
            results.append({"feedback_id": fid, "observations": obs})
        return fake_response(json.dumps({"results": results}))
    return build

def test_api_error_mapping_never_leaks_request_content():
    cases = [
        (status_error(openai.AuthenticationError, 401), "auth", False),
        (status_error(openai.PermissionDeniedError, 403), "auth", False),
        (status_error(openai.RateLimitError, 429, {"retry-after": "7"}), "rate_limited", True),
        (status_error(openai.InternalServerError, 500), "api_error", True),
        (status_error(openai.BadRequestError, 400), "bad_request", False),
        (openai.APIConnectionError(request=REQ), "connection", True),
        (openai.APITimeoutError(request=REQ), "connection", True),
    ]
    for exc, kind_, retryable in cases:
        llm = OpenAILLMClient(settings(), client=FakeSDK([exc]))
        with pytest.raises(LLMError) as err:
            llm.complete_json(system="s", user="SECRET CUSTOMER COMMENT", schema=conn.SCHEMA, max_tokens=10)
        assert (err.value.kind, err.value.retryable) == (kind_, retryable)
        assert "SECRET CUSTOMER COMMENT" not in str(err.value)
    llm = OpenAILLMClient(settings(), client=FakeSDK([status_error(openai.RateLimitError, 429, {"retry-after": "7"})]))
    with pytest.raises(LLMError) as err:
        llm.complete_json(system="s", user="u", schema=conn.SCHEMA, max_tokens=10)
    assert err.value.retry_after_s == 7.0

def test_extraction_retry_and_budget_accounting_with_openai(s):
    cats = category_map(s)
    ids = sorted(cats)[:12]
    sdk = FakeSDK([status_error(openai.InternalServerError, 500), status_error(openai.RateLimitError, 429)],
                  builder=observation_builder(lambda f: cats[f]))
    st = settings()
    job = ai.run_extraction(s, OpenAILLMClient(st, client=sdk), st, ids, spec=ai.observation_spec(st),
                            sleep=lambda _: None)
    assert job.status == "completed" and job.processed_items == 12
    calls = list(s.scalars(select(AIApiCall).where(AIApiCall.job_id == job.job_id).order_by(AIApiCall.call_id)))
    assert [c.status for c in calls][:2] == ["api_error", "rate_limited"]
    ok = [c for c in calls if c.status == "succeeded"]
    assert len(ok) == 2  # 12 comments, batch size 10
    one = estimate_cost_usd(MODEL, LLMUsage(input_tokens=400, cache_read_tokens=600, output_tokens=300))
    assert all(c.estimated_cost_usd == pytest.approx(one) for c in ok)
    b = budget.budget_status(s, st)
    assert b.spent_usd == pytest.approx(round(2 * one, 4), abs=1e-4)
    assert b.retry_or_failed_calls >= 2 and b.remaining_usd == pytest.approx(26 - b.spent_usd)
    # cache reuse: a second run sends nothing
    sent = len(sdk.requests)
    ai.run_extraction(s, OpenAILLMClient(st, client=sdk), st, ids, spec=ai.observation_spec(st), sleep=lambda _: None)
    assert len(sdk.requests) == sent
    # the estimate now uses OpenAI pricing and measured tokens
    est = budget.estimate_cost(s, ai.load_comments(s, sorted(cats)[12:32]), ai.observation_spec(st), st)
    assert est.basis.startswith("measured") and est.estimated_usd < 0.05
